motions.name: Midnight curtain lens reveal
motions.trigger: initial hero entrance or scroll chapter enter
motions.easing: cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1) for curtain, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) for lens settle

keyframes.state: Curtain folds closed; lens is a narrow horizontal slit; bottle is shadowed.
Curtain compresses inward 8px; brass hardware marks tighten.
Curtain opens; moon circle expands into lens aperture; bottle silhouette begins reveal.
Bottle rises 12px; hero keyline draws on; smoke marks remain behind text-safe zones.
Editorial headline and CTA are stable; lens and bottle are final.

motions.reducedMotionFallback: Render final open lens and bottle immediately. Keep only 100-160ms button/focus feedback. No curtain slide, path morph, or smoke motion.
motions.handoffNotes: Use CSS transforms and clip-path for curtain/lens when possible. Use SVG attributes for lens geometry. Avoid runtime Figma Motion.

motions.name: Scent bottle morph
motions.trigger: chapter transition from abstract product frame to hero bottle

keyframes.state: Top edge narrows to imply neck anchor.
Shoulders, neck, stopper, and base separate into bottle proportions.
Bottle keyline and inner shadow settle.

motions.reducedMotionFallback: Replace morph with static final bottle after chapter change.
motions.handoffNotes: Use normalized SVG paths only. Do not claim arbitrary Figma vector paths morph cleanly until point structure is normalized.

motions.name: Smoke note draw-on

keyframes.state: Stroke draws on behind scent-note label.
Smoke opacity drops to background level.
Smoke mark static, behind text-safe zone.

motions.reducedMotionFallback: Smoke mark appears static at final opacity with no draw-on.
motions.handoffNotes: Decorative only. Mark aria-hidden and keep behind content.
